name: stir-features
title: Stir Features
description: A bento of feature cards where each picture is a small working product. Tickets roll through a stack, people join and wave, a thread types itself out, chips drag and spring home, and teammates resize a chart while you watch. Loops stop off screen and step aside while you're using a card.
blurb: Feature cards that are small working products.
note: every card moves. drag the chips
